description: Assign a price list to a company record; null unassigns. Every member of the company pays this list - one list per buyer, and a member's own list is ignored while they belong to the company. A company without a list leaves its members on catalogue prices. Refused for a record that is not a company (a model with the Company capability) - for a customer use set_customer_price_list. Returns the record id and its priceListId.

priceListId.description: The price list's id (from list_price_lists); null unassigns

recordId.description: The company record's id (a record of a model with the Company capability; a customer's company.id)

name: set_company_price_list
title: Set company price list
